title: Meibukan Gojyu Karate Winnipeg Dojo

services.name: Meibukan Gojyu Karate Winnipeg
services.desc: Sensei Michael Marshall has been training in martial arts since 1989. He is a 4th degree black belt in International Meibukan Gojyu Karate. Sensei Mike received his first degree black belt October 6, 1995 at the age of 19 under Sensei Steven Picotte, (Canada Goju Karate Association). Sensei Mike continued his studies under his father Sensei Kim Marshall when the family moved to Winnipeg in 1993 until his father's passing on October 2nd, 2016. Sensei Mike Marshall is a devoted husband and father of four children. "I am both honoured and humbled to continue my father's legacy, he built such an amazing community here at our dojo and had such a positive influence on so many people's lives."

blurb: The Meibukan Gojyu Karate Winnipeg Dojo (school) teaches a traditional style of Okinawa Karate. We have been proud members of Winnipeg’s martial arts community since 1993 and in our current location since 1999.
